hero.eyebrow: Software for private bond issuers and asset managers
hero.title: Issue and manage private bonds,
hero.titleAccent: from first draft to final redemption.
hero.subtitle: Veris Assets structures your bonds and notes, qualifies your professional investors, collects subscriptions and keeps the registry. Coupons, redemptions and reporting follow — with no spreadsheet.

preview.label: An illustrative issuance, as shown in the product

preview.description: Helps finance a 12 MWp solar farm on former industrial land near Toulouse, France.

lifecycle.title: The whole life of an issuance, in one place
lifecycle.subtitle: From the first draft to the last redemption, every step follows clear statuses, with the right person deciding at the right time.

structure.title: Structure
structure.text: Create the issuance in a guided wizard: terms, schedule, eligibility rules and documents, approved with four eyes.

onboard.title: Onboard
onboard.text: Qualify investors with KYC/KYB files, beneficial owners and eligibility checks explained in plain language.

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.text: Investors subscribe online; the issuer reviews, approves and follows each request.

allocate.title: Allocate
allocate.text: Allocate oversubscribed issuances fairly, validate with four eyes and confirm fictitious payments.

register.title: Register
register.text: Keep the registry of positions, blockings and transfers, reconciled every day.

service.title: Service and report
service.text: Calculate coupons and redemptions from a registry snapshot, generate payment instructions, notices and exports.

audiences.title: One platform, three points of view

issuers.title: Issuers and asset managers
issuers.p1: A dashboard and a "To do" queue instead of spreadsheets
issuers.p2: Allocation, registry and coupons with no manual reconciliation
issuers.p3: CSV exports and generated documents, ready to send
issuers.lead: Raise and service private debt without the back-office burden.

investors.title: Professional investors
investors.p1: One portfolio view: positions, coupons and documents
investors.p2: Subscriptions and transfers online, checked before execution
investors.p3: Notices and documents in their language
investors.lead: Find the real-asset issuances you are invited to, and follow them in one place.

compliance.title: Compliance and audit
compliance.p2: Eligibility checked before every subscription and transfer
compliance.lead: Control every step, and show how it was done.

audiences.subtitle: Everyone works from the same registry, and sees only what they should.

security.title: Security and traceability by design
security.subtitle: Controls are built into the platform, not added afterwards.

mfa.title: Strong authentication
mfa.text: Two-factor authentication for administrators and compliance officers, sessions that expire, accounts locked after repeated failures.

isolation.title: Tenant isolation
isolation.text: The organisation is always determined by the server, and the database itself refuses access to another organisation's data.

ledger.title: Tamper-evident registry
ledger.text: Movements are never modified: corrections are counter-entries, and a daily check verifies the whole chain.

audit.title: Complete audit trail
audit.text: Who did what, when and from where, with values before and after, sensitive data masked.

documents.title: Controlled documents
documents.text: File types checked on their content, temporary download links, confidential files traced.

hosting.title: European hosting

technology.title: An architecture built so that the registry can be trusted
technology.subtitle: How Veris Assets keeps an exact, traceable and isolated record of every private asset it administers — and what it deliberately does not claim.

overview.title: Four layers, each with one job
overview.subtitle: Every request goes through the same path. Nothing reaches the data without passing the checks of each layer.

browser.title: Your browser
browser.text: Encrypted connection (HTTPS), strict content security policy, session cookie unreadable by scripts.

web.title: Web application
web.text: Screens in English and French. It holds no data: it relays each request to the API.

api.title: API
api.text: Identity, permissions, four-eyes rules and business checks, then one database transaction per operation.

database.title: Database
database.text: PostgreSQL with row-level isolation per organisation and an append-only ledger protected by the database itself.

ledger.title: An append-only ledger
ledger.p1: The registry of positions is rebuilt from a ledger of movements: issuance, allocation, blocking, transfer, redemption. The ledger is the source of truth; positions are only its result.
ledger.p2: A movement is never modified nor deleted. The database refuses it, whoever asks — the application included. A mistake is corrected by a counter-entry, approved by a second person, so the history always shows what happened and how it was put right.

points.p1: Positions always equal the sum of their movements
points.p2: No negative holding, no unit created out of nothing
points.p3: Corrections by counter-entry, with four eyes

hash.title: Movements chained by hash
hash.p1: Each movement carries a SHA-256 fingerprint of its content and of the fingerprint of the movement before it. Changing one movement, even by one digit, would break every fingerprint that follows.
hash.p2: Every night, a check recomputes the whole chain and rebuilds the positions from the ledger. Any difference is written in the audit log and reported to the administrators; nothing is repaired automatically.
hash.example: Movement n + 1 = SHA-256(content + fingerprint of movement n)

isolation.title: Each organisation sees only its own data
isolation.p1: The organisation of a user is always determined by the server from the identity, never from what the browser sends. An attempt to reach another organisation's data answers as if it did not exist, and is logged.
isolation.p2: Isolation does not rely on the application alone: the database applies it to every row, and the application connects with a role that has only the rights it needs.

points.p3: Every route tested against every role on each change

hosting.title: European hosting
hosting.p1: The demonstration runs in a European data centre (Amsterdam, Netherlands): application, database, documents and backups.
hosting.p2: The database is backed up every night; each backup is checked against a manifest (row counts and ledger fingerprint), and restoring it is tested automatically.

reliability.title: Why the platform can be relied on

fourEyes.title: Four eyes
fourEyes.text: Allocations, distributions, payments and corrections need a second person: nobody validates their own operation.

audit.title: Complete audit trail
audit.text: Who did what, when and from where, with values before and after; sensitive data masked.

exact.title: Exact amounts
exact.text: Every amount is computed in exact decimals, never in floating point: a coupon of €2,500.00 is exactly €2,500.00.

idempotent.title: No double operation
idempotent.text: A request sent twice — a double click, a network retry — is executed once.

tests.title: Tested on every change
tests.text: Several hundred automated tests, including real browser scenarios, run before any change is accepted.

access.title: Protected access
access.text: Two-factor authentication for administrators and compliance officers, alerts on unusual access, emergency access traced.

scope.title: What Veris Assets does not claim
scope.text: Veris Assets is a demonstration: fictitious data, fictitious payments and identity checks, no blockchain required. It makes no claim of regulatory approval or authorisation. Its architecture is designed to integrate your compliance controls and is compatible with a future ERC-3643 integration.
